workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Queries SMP/E for applied, held, and errored PTFs in a target zone

variable.name: CSI_DATASET
variable.label: CSI Dataset Name
variable.abstract: Fully qualified name of the SMP/E global CSI dataset
variable.description: The SMP/E global CSI (Consolidated Software Inventory) dataset. All GIMSMP queries are directed at this dataset.

variable.name: TARGET_ZONE
variable.label: Target Zone Name
variable.abstract: SMP/E target zone to query (e.g. JAVATZ)
variable.description: The name of the SMP/E target zone to query for applied PTFs.

variable.name: FMID_FILTER
variable.label: FMID Filter (optional)
variable.abstract: Limit the applied PTF query to a specific FMID (e.g. AZWE003). Leave blank for all.
variable.description: When set, the listAppliedPtfs step filters output to PTFs belonging to this FMID. Leave blank to report all PTFs in the target zone. Zowe V3 FMID is AZWE003.

variable.name: REPORT_PATH
variable.label: Report Output Path
variable.abstract: USS path where the summary report will be written
variable.description: The full USS path for the PTF status report output file.

step.name: checkCsi
step.title: Confirm CSI Dataset Exists
step.description: Runs LISTCAT against the CSI dataset to confirm it exists and is accessible before running GIMSMP queries.
step.instructions:
Runs tsocmd LISTCAT ENT(${instance-CSI_DATASET}) to confirm the CSI dataset exists and is accessible.
PASS : Dataset found FAIL : Dataset not found or not accessible

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh CSI="${instance-CSI_DATASET}" echo "=== CSI Dataset Check ===" echo "CSI : $CSI" echo "-------------------------" OUT=$(tsocmd "LISTCAT ENT($CSI)" 2>&1) RC=$? echo "$OUT" | head -10 echo "-------------------------" if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then echo "RESULT : PASS (CSI $CSI found)" else echo "RESULT : FAIL (LISTCAT RC=$RC - check CSI name and access)" fi

step.name: listAppliedPtfs
step.title: List Applied PTFs
step.description: Runs GIMSMP in batch to query all applied PTFs in the target zone. If FMID_FILTER is set, the SMPCNTL FORFMID operand limits output to that FMID.
step.instructions:
Submits GIMSMP with: SET BDY(${instance-TARGET_ZONE}). QUERY SYSMODS TYPE(PTF) APPLYCHECK FORFMID(${instance-FMID_FILTER}).
Review SYSPRINT on the spool for the full list of applied PTFs. SMP/E RC=0 is clean; RC=4 means informational messages only (still a pass for this check).
PASS : RC 0 or 4 FAIL : RC 8 or higher

step.name: reportMissingFix
step.title: Report Missing Fixes (FIXCAT)
step.description: Runs GIMSMP REPORT MISSINGFIX to identify any IBM-required PTFs not yet applied in the target zone. Checks the z/OS required service fix categories.
step.instructions:
Submits GIMSMP REPORT MISSINGFIX against zone ${instance-TARGET_ZONE} checking fix categories: IBM.TargetSystem-RequiredService.z/OS.V2R5 IBM.DrivingSystem-RequiredService
Any PTFs listed in the output are IBM-required fixes not yet applied. These should be evaluated and scheduled for the next maintenance window.
PASS : RC 0 or 4 (report generated, may list missing fixes) FAIL : RC 8 or higher (SMP/E error)

step.name: listHoldPtfs
step.title: List PTFs in HOLD Status
step.description: Runs GIMSMP to query PTFs with HOLD status in the target zone. HOLD PTFs block apply processing and must be resolved before installing dependent PTFs.
step.instructions:
Submits GIMSMP QUERY SYSMODS TYPE(PTF) HOLD against zone ${instance-TARGET_ZONE}.
A HOLD means IBM has issued HOLDDATA against the PTF — usually a PE (product error), dependency, or defect. Each held PTF must be investigated before bypassing.
PASS : RC 0 or 4 FAIL : RC 8 or higher

step.name: listErrorPtfs
step.title: List PTFs in ERROR Status
step.description: Runs GIMSMP to query PTFs with ERROR status in the target zone. ERROR PTFs indicate a failed apply or receive operation that needs remediation.
step.instructions:
Submits GIMSMP QUERY SYSMODS TYPE(PTF) STATUS(ERROR) against zone ${instance-TARGET_ZONE}.
An ERROR status means a previous SMP/E operation failed and left the zone inconsistent. Must be resolved before further SMP/E operations.
PASS : RC 0 or 4 FAIL : RC 8 or higher

step.name: approvalGate
step.title: PTF Report Sign-Off
step.description: Manual step. Operator reviews all PTF query spool outputs and signs off before the final report is written.
step.instructions:
Review the SYSPRINT spool output from all preceding steps:
checkCsi — CSI ${instance-CSI_DATASET} accessible? listAppliedPtfs — PTFs applied for ${instance-FMID_FILTER}? reportMissingFix — Any IBM-required fixes missing? listHoldPtfs — Any HOLD PTFs to investigate? listErrorPtfs — Any ERROR PTFs to remediate?
Mark complete when satisfied the PTF status is documented.

step.name: writeReport
step.title: Write PTF Status Report
step.description: Writes a timestamped PTF status report to REPORT_PATH on USS and surfaces it on the JES spool for attaching to a change record.
step.instructions: Writes the PTF status report to ${instance-REPORT_PATH}. Attach this to the change record for the maintenance window. Run before and after PTF application for a before/after diff.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh REPORT="${instance-REPORT_PATH}" TS=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') echo "Writing PTF status report to $REPORT" echo "============================================================" > "$REPORT" echo " SMP/E PTF Status Report" >> "$REPORT" echo " Generated : $TS" >> "$REPORT" echo "============================================================" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "CONFIGURATION" >> "$REPORT" echo " CSI dataset : ${instance-CSI_DATASET}" >> "$REPORT" echo " Target zone : ${instance-TARGET_ZONE}" >> "$REPORT" echo " FMID filter : ${instance-FMID_FILTER}" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "QUERIES PERFORMED" >> "$REPORT" echo " 1. CSI accessible - see checkCsi step output" >> "$REPORT" echo " 2. Applied PTFs - see listAppliedPtfs SYSPRINT" >> "$REPORT" echo " 3. Missing fixes - see reportMissingFix SYSPRINT" >> "$REPORT" echo " 4. PTFs in HOLD - see listHoldPtfs SYSPRINT" >> "$REPORT" echo " 5. PTFs in ERROR - see listErrorPtfs SYSPRINT" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "SIGN-OFF" >> "$REPORT" echo " Reviewed at : $TS" >> "$REPORT" echo " Workflow : smpe-ptf-status v1.1" >> "$REPORT" echo "" >> "$REPORT" echo "============================================================" >> "$REPORT" echo " Attach to change record for maintenance window evidence." >> "$REPORT" echo "============================================================" >> "$REPORT" echo "" echo "=== Report written to $REPORT ===" cat "$REPORT"
